author: KEXP
description: Led by saxophonist and clarinetist Chris Speed, experimental group Yeah NO craft an intense fusion of jazz, rock, Eastern folk, and minimalism to push the boundaries of sound. Their latest in-studio session offers a performance of "Camper Giorno" and more with host John Gilbreath.
title: Yeah NO performs "Camper Giorno" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Yeah NO performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded April 16, 2026.

She Has Four Thorns 11:08

Skúli Sverrisson - Bass

Host: John Gilbreath
